api_endpoints.purpose: Attach tags to an existing link

components.name: TagInput
components.purpose: Input for adding tags to a link

components.name: TagList
components.purpose: Display tags attached to a link

acceptance_criteria.text: When tags are posted to an existing link, the system shall attach them and return 200 with the link reporting every attached tag.
When a tag already attached to a link is posted again, the system shall return 200 and leave the tag attached exactly once.
When links are listed with a tag filter, the system shall return exactly the links carrying that tag.
If tags are posted to a link id that does not exist, then the system shall return 404 and create no tag rows.

gaps.body: Whether a tag with no remaining links is deleted or kept is undecided. Keeping them makes an autocomplete list easy and lets the list rot.
